name: liander2024-energy-forecasting-benchmark
description:
Dataset Card for Liander 2024 Short Term Energy Forecasting Benchmark
	


This dataset provides a benchmark for short term energy forecasting models, combining electrical load measurements from Dutch DSO Liander with predictors like corresponding weather data from OpenMeteo, day-ahead electricity prices from ENTSO-E, and profiles of electricity consumption from Energiedatawijzer. evaluation_method: MAE (Mean Absolute Error); commonly reported alongside RMSE/MAPE
reputation: Official 2024 short‑term forecasting benchmark released by OpenSTEF/Liander for the energy forecasting community in the Netherlands; intended for operational and research use.
